course_name: 深度學習與太空科技應用
outline: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of deep learning techniques and their applications in space technology. It covers the fundamentals of neural networks, advanced deep learning architectures, and practical applications in space data analysis and autonomous systems. Students will gain hands-on experience with popular deep learning frameworks and real-world space technology datasets.
schedule:
Week 1: Introduction to Space Technology and Earth Observation
Week 2: Remote-Sensing Data Fundamentals
Week 3: Space Image Processing and Data Preparation
Week 4: Deep-Learning Foundations for Space Applications
Week 5: Convolutional Neural Networks for Earth Observation
Week 6: Tiny-Object Detection in Satellite Imagery
Week 7: Midterm Examination and Project Proposal
Week 8: Semantic Segmentation and Change Detection
Week 9: Advanced CNNs and Efficient Onboard Inference
Week 10: Vision Transformers and Foundation Models for Earth Observation
Week 11: Generative AI for Remote-Sensing Images
Week 12: Autoencoders and Anomaly Detection
Week 13: Advanced Space-AI Applications
Week 14: Deep Reinforcement Learning and Autonomous Space Systems
Week 15: Onboard and Agentic AI for Space Missions
Week 16: Security, Reliability, and Ethics of Space AI
Week 17: Final Project Reports and Presentations I
Week 18: Final Project Reports and Presentations II
assessment:
Laboratory exercises and assignments: 25%
Midterm examination: 30%
Project proposal and progress review: 10%
Final project implementation or technical report: 15%
Final presentation and peer evaluation: 15%
Participation and in-class activities: 5%
